newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle higher, nearby spread active.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle higher, nearby spread active.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed higher as players focused on the nearby switch ahead of first notice day for May, market sources said.
July settled at a 2.95 premium to May compared to a 2.30 premium Tuesday.
Thursday is the first notice day for May delivery, which ended down 0.35 cent at 73.00 cents per lb. Most-active July settled 1.00 lower at 75.95 cents.
Volume was estimated at 4,000 lots compared to Tuesday's official 9,168 lots.
Support was cited at 70.00 cents for July juice, while producer selling could limit gains around 78.40 cents.
Trading sources noted light speculative and local.
No change was noted in the weak fundamental outlook as players await Brazil's 1997/98 crop estimate, released May 20.
